scripts.test: pnpm --filter @jingling/core test && pnpm --filter @jingling/presentation test && pnpm --filter @jingling/platform test
scripts.sync:core: pnpm --filter @jingling/core exec esbuild src/creator-entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=../../assets/scripts/vendor/jinglingCore.ts --banner:js='/* generated from packages/core — do not edit */'
scripts.sync:presentation: pnpm --filter @jingling/presentation exec esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=../../assets/scripts/vendor/jinglingPresentation.ts --banner:js='/* generated from packages/presentation — do not edit */'
scripts.test:py: uv run --directory tools --extra dev pytest && uv run --directory server --extra dev pytest
scripts.check:release: uv run --project tools python tools/check_release_acceptance.py --evidence docs/ui/baselines/evidence/2026-09-01
